servicesPage.headerSubtitle: Flexible options for every goal and budget. Start for free — scale when you're ready.
servicesPage.packagesSubtitle: All packages work for both Soft Skills and English Coaching.
servicesPage.ctaSubtitle: A free 30-minute call is the easiest way to find out if we're a good fit.
servicesPage.faq1a: All sessions are held online via video call (Zoom or Google Meet). After booking, you receive a confirmation with the meeting link and a short intake form.
servicesPage.faq2q: Can I combine Soft Skills and English coaching?
servicesPage.faq2a: Absolutely — many clients work on both. We can build a custom programme that covers both areas, tailored to your professional context.
servicesPage.faq3q: What if I want to cancel or reschedule?
servicesPage.faq3a: You can reschedule or cancel up to 24 hours before the session at no cost. Cancellations within 24 hours are charged at 50%.
servicesPage.faq4a: Yes! For teams and organisations, get in touch via email for a tailored proposal. Group sessions and workshops are also available.
